command.description: The command words that were checked, such as `ec2 describe-instances`.

output.description: The command's JSON output, parsed and redacted; null when it was empty, not JSON or truncated.

text.description: The output as text, redacted, when it is not parsed JSON (for example when truncated).

bytes.description: Bytes of stdout kept, at most 1 MiB (1048576).

truncated.description: True when stdout passed 1 MiB and was cut.

stderr.description: The command's stderr, redacted and cut at 64 KiB.
